_comment: Lean routing: the model you pick runs everything — main session, sub-agents and goal verification inherit it, and Jev only adjusts thinking effort. There are no automatic model-selection chains, no observer/council/quality roles, and no silent fallback to a different model. Copy to ~/.pi/settings/llm_preferences.json only to pin an explicit user-chosen override; an absent file means inherit. If a task needs a capability the current model lacks (e.g. images), the harness says so and you switch with /model — it never switches for you.

subagents._note: Empty = inherit the main session model exactly (default). Add routes only as an explicit user override.

main_session_fallback._note: Empty = no automatic fallback. A failed route is reported; the user chooses what to do.
